description: Re-enable a webhook disabled after 24 hours of failed deliveries (disabled_reason failing), once its endpoint works again; the next delivery is usually a files.resync. A webhook disabled as access_revoked cannot be re-enabled (error access_revoked): create a new one with `mountable webhooks create`. Safe to retry. org_id is optional: an API key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.
name: enable_webhook
